propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded between 'author forgot' and 'touches no repo file'; the tri-state model adds an explicit 'none' declaration to disambiguate.

FILE_IMPACT event payload gains optional keys file_impact_scope and no_file_impact_reason; reducer state derives file_impact_scope as 'paths', 'none', or 'undeclared' based on event payload and file_impact array presence.
CLI set-file-impact command moves from fixed-arity _REGISTRY to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY and accepts two mutually exclusive forms: JSON array (existing) or --none flag with reason text.
File-impact reason text must contain at least 10 non-whitespace characters; violations exit with code 2 and write no event.
Library function get_file_impact_scope returns tri-state kind alongside reason and paths; MCP tool declare_no_file_impact applies identical validation and writes no canonical output schema.
Reducer state transitions between the three kinds are mutually exclusive via last-writer-wins replacement in process_file_impact, e.g., paths→none→paths cycles correctly.
